name: What factors have the biggest impact on room renovation costs?

mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on room renovation costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on square footage, material selections, and whether you are changing the layout or keeping existing walls. Retaining your existing floor plan keeps costs predictable because it eliminates major structural framing and mechanical rerouting. High-end finishes, such as marble or specialty tile installation, intricate trim molding, and extensive drywall repair, will raise material and labor costs. Working directly with a hands-on general contractor who handles finish carpentry, tile, and paint in-house helps control costs compared to managing multiple separate specialty subcontractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Layout changes, structural framing, plumbing or electrical moves, and high-end materials like marble tile have the largest impact on your total renovation budget.
